description: This Java class defines step definitions for Cucumber BDD tests related to login functionalities of the OrangeHRM application, including handling various login scenarios, validation, and redirection.

classes.name: LoginSteps
classes.description: Step definitions for login-related scenarios in Cucumber BDD tests, including login process, validation, redirection, and error handling.

methods.name: theOrangeHRMApplicationIsAccessible
methods.description: Verifies that the OrangeHRM application is accessible at the base URL.

methods.name: theDatabaseIsInAKnownCleanState
methods.description: Assumes the database is in a clean state, managed externally.

methods.name: theUserIsOnTheLoginPage
methods.description: Navigates to the login page at the specified path.

methods.name: theAdminUserIsLoggedIn
methods.description: Performs login as an admin user and waits for dashboard URL.

methods.name: anESSUserIsLoggedIn
methods.description: Performs login as an ESS user and waits for dashboard URL.

methods.name: aUserAccountExistsThatHasBeenDisabled
methods.description: Precondition for disabled user account, assumed to be configured in test data.

methods.name: anEmployeeHasBeenTerminatedButTheUserAccountStillExists
methods.description: Precondition for terminated employee with active user account, assumed in test data.

methods.name: theUserIsOnThePage
methods.description: Navigates to a specified page and waits for load.

methods.name: noUserIsLoggedIn
methods.description: Clears cookies to ensure no user is logged in.

methods.name: theUserEntersUsernameAndPassword
methods.description: Enters username and password into the respective input fields.

methods.name: theUserClicksTheButton
methods.description: Clicks a button based on its text.

methods.name: theUserClicksTheButtonWithoutEnteringCredentials
methods.description: Clicks a button without entering any credentials.

methods.name: theUserEntersValidCredentialsAndSubmitsTheForm
methods.description: Enters valid admin credentials and submits login form.

methods.name: theDisabledUserAttemptsToLogInWithValidCredentials
methods.description: Attempts login as a disabled user with placeholder credentials.

methods.name: theTerminatedEmployeeAttemptsToLogIn
methods.description: Attempts login as a terminated employee.

methods.name: theSessionTimesOut
methods.description: Simulates session timeout by deleting cookies.

methods.name: theUserIsRedirectedToTheLoginPage
methods.description: Navigates to dashboard URL to trigger redirect to login.

methods.name: theUserLogsInAgainWithValidCredentials
methods.description: Logs in again with valid credentials.

methods.name: theUserNavigatesToTheLoginPage
methods.description: Navigates to a specified login page URL.

methods.name: theUserAttemptsToNavigateDirectlyTo
methods.description: Attempts navigation directly to a specified path.

methods.name: theUserShouldBeRedirectedToTheDashboard
methods.description: Verifies redirection to dashboard page.

methods.name: theFieldShouldDisplayValidationError
methods.description: Checks that a given input field displays a specific validation error.

methods.name: theLoginPageShouldDisplayAnErrorMessage
methods.description: Verifies that a specific error message is visible on the login page.

methods.name: theLoginPageShouldDisplayAnErrorMessage
methods.description: Verifies that an error or validation message is displayed on login page.

methods.name: theUserShouldRemainOnTheLoginPage
methods.description: Ensures the user stays on the login page after failed login.

methods.name: thePOSTToShouldReturnARedirectResponse
methods.description: Verifies redirect after POST request (implicit via URL change).

methods.name: theLoginLogoImageShouldBeVisible
methods.description: Checks that the login logo image is visible.

methods.name: theLoginBannerImageShouldBeVisible
methods.description: Checks that the login banner image is visible (may not always be present).

methods.name: theSocialMediaSectionShouldBeDisplayedAsConfigured
methods.description: Verifies visibility of social media section on login page.

methods.name: theLoginFormShouldContainAHiddenCSRFTokenField
methods.description: Checks for presence of CSRF token field in login form.

methods.name: theCSRFTokenShouldBeIncludedInThePOSTRequestTo
methods.description: Verifies CSRF token inclusion via successful login.

methods.name: theUserShouldBeRedirectedToTheHomePageViaHomePageService
methods.description: Verifies redirection away from login page.

methods.name: noScriptExecutionShouldOccur
methods.description: Checks that no XSS script execution occurs by verifying absence of alert dialog.

methods.name: theUserShouldBeRedirectedBackTo
methods.description: Verifies redirect back to a specified URL.

methods.name: theUserLogsInAgainWithUsernameAndPassword
methods.description: Re-performs login with specific credentials.

methods.name: performLogin
methods.description: Helper method to perform login with given credentials, navigating to login page, filling form, and submitting.
